criteriaNotes.1_topdown_view: Reads correctly as the inside of a dome rising over the round room in the RM 3/4 convention: the drum/cornice ring sits on the stepped wall tops, courses curve and darken upward, four ribs converge toward a crown cut by the map top edge. No iso/side faces. Consistent with the stepped room plan below.
criteriaNotes.2_style_fit: Stone courses, outline weight and the running-bond drum match the v5 wall ramps; ribs have a proper 3-step timber ramp lit top-left with brass collars. Fault: the sky slit (x=228..251, y=0..47) is three hard flat colour bands (10,26,58) y0-17 / (17,52,97) y18-35 / (24,78,136) y36-47 with no dither between them - flat banding unlike anything else on the sheet. Minor: blotchy lighter rectangles in the outer shell, e.g. (65,65,76) block at x~23..27,y~69..77 left (right side has an asymmetric patch), read as smudges rather than courses.
criteriaNotes.3_readability_1x: Strong improvement: at 1x in mock-obs.png the hall now clearly reads as a round domed observatory hall with a star slit, close to ref-op3. The centre meridian is the focal point, which is exactly where the seam below is.
criteriaNotes.4_placement: Dome meets the stepped wall tops cleanly and the cornice lands directly over the centre wall row. Fails at the slit hand-off: at y=47->48 the sky jumps from the lightest band (24,78,136) back to the darkest navy (10,26,58) of the dome-slit-tall top tile, and the jambs switch from (96,104,120) stone to (51,57,66)/(73,80,93) alternating at the same row, so the slit visibly restarts (a dark box with the moon) right under the cornice instead of continuing. Minor: at the far bottom-left/right (x~0..2, y~112..127) a sliver of black ceiling shows between the drum edge and the hall's side-wall corner post.
criteriaNotes.5_silhouette_outline: Outer silhouette is a clean dark outline with smooth stepping; rib feet sit on the cornice; transparent notch for the slit is exact. No stray pixels found apart from the shell smudges noted under style.

items.name: 천문대 둥근 지붕(큰 방 천장 띠 전체, 30×8) (dome vault)
items.reasons: Composition, 3/4 reading, ribs, cornice and drum are good and the hall now reads as a domed observatory. Fails on the centre slit, the most-looked-at feature: (1) Sky gradient seam at y=47/48: the dome's slit ends on its lightest blue (24,78,136) and the existing 'dome slit tall' top tile starts on darkest navy (10,26,58). Fix: reverse/re-ramp the dome's slit so it is lightest at the crown (y=0) and reaches (10,26,58) by y~44-47 (or match whatever the slit tile's y=48 row is), so the sky is one continuous ramp. (2) Flat banding: the three bands at y=0-17/18-35/36-47 are hard-edged flat fills; add a 2-row checker dither at each band boundary (as on the slit-tall tile at y~45-47 of the window) or reduce to a single ramp with dithered transitions. (3) Jamb discontinuity at y=48: dome jambs (x=228-229 and x=250-251) are a flat (96,104,120); the slit tile's jambs at y>=48 are (51,57,66)/(73,80,93). Shade the dome jambs with the same two tones (light inner edge, dark outer) for the last ~8 rows so they run into the slit tile without a colour jump. Minor, fix while there: (4) clean the lighter flat patches in the outer shell (left x~23-27,y~69-77; check the mirrored right area x~452-457) into proper course lines, and make left/right shells symmetric in tone; (5) extend the drum by 1-2 px at the bottom outer corners (x=0..2 and x=477..479, y~112..127) so no black ceiling sliver shows against the hall's side-wall corner.
